senses.definition: before a countable noun: A large, indefinite number of.
examples: Not many such people enjoyed playing chess.
There are very many different ways to cook a meal.
We spent many hours and days training, but running clubs boast many hundreds of faster members.

quotes.text: Investors face a quandary. Cash offers a return of virtually zero in many developed countries; government-bond yields may have risen in recent weeks but they are still unattractive. senses.definition: before a countable noun: (in combinations such as 'as many', 'so many', 'this many') Used to indicate, demonstrate or compare the number of people or things.
examples: We don't need this many bananas. Put some back.
There may be as many as ten million species of insect.
I don't have as many friends as my sister does.

senses.definition: A large, indefinite number of people or things.
examples: Many are called, but few are chosen.

quotes.text: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us...

examples: Democracy must balance the rights of the few against the will of the many.
